concept: Redshift: petabyte-scale data warehouse for analytics
tests: Choosing a service for a petabyte-scale data warehouse with complex analytical queries and joins.
expected: Amazon Redshift — columnar MPP warehouse optimized for complex analytics over huge structured datasets. Triggers: "petabyte-scale data warehouse", "complex analytical queries and joins".
why_not: DynamoDB — NoSQL key-value without complex joins; RDS PostgreSQL doesn't scale well to petabyte analytics; ElastiCache — in-memory cache.
